d: The Orange County Choppers crew takes on a high-tech custom motorcycle build inspired by Sikorsky Aircraft and its iconic helicopters. On American Chopper, Paul Teutul Sr., Paul Jr., and the team explore aviation engineering before bringing aircraft-inspired details into a street-legal chopper. From turbine-style exhaust and rotor-inspired components to custom aluminum bodywork, this build showcases the craftsmanship behind ambitious custom motorcycle builds.
